annotations.text: A ten-byte opaque protocol designed for clustering, byte-position entropy, counters, state fields, and checksum exploration.

limitations: Normal timestamps are host arrival timestamps, not wire-edge timestamps.
A conventional USB serial adapter does not provide an analog voltage waveform.
Direction inference, when present, must be treated as inferred evidence.
Electrical standard, voltage, pinout, polarity, termination, bias, and ground were not verified by LINEGLASS.
